hero_data.hero_paragraph: Lamborghini — Italian maker of extreme supercars founded in 1963 by Ferruccio Lamborghini. Known for aggressive design, V10/V12 engines, carbon-fiber bodies, and models like the Aventador and Huracán. Focus: performance, speed, and bold styling.
Tuntun Mausi (Tuntun Ladoo) — Cheerful sweet-maker in the animated series Chhota Bheem. Famous for her delicious ladoos that give Bheem strength. Kind, supportive, and loved in Dholakpur.

Spices of India — India grows diverse spices: turmeric, cumin, coriander, cardamom, cloves, cinnamon, black pepper, mustard, fenugreek, saffron, chili, asafoetida, bay leaf, fennel, nutmeg, mace, star anise. They add aroma, heat, color, and medicinal value to cuisine.
